audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes the blind to Vault (E) and claims Vault knocks Gragas back. Both are wrong. Blinding Assault is Q; Vault displaces QUINN, not you.
audit.why: Riot text, Quinn Q Blinding Assault (11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, 1025 range): 'Quinn calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision.' Riot text, Quinn E Vault (12/11/10/9/8s, 675 range): 'Quinn dashes to an enemy... Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target.' The blind is on Q and the reposition is Quinn's own — no knockback is applied to Gragas.
audit.corrected: Bait Blinding Assault (Q) before you spend your W-empowered auto; Vault only buys Quinn distance, so treat it as her escape, not your displacement.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that her Q outranges your Q, which is why the poke war is unwinnable.
audit.why: Blinding Assault range 1025 vs Barrel Roll range 850. She wins any static ranged exchange by 175 units.
audit.corrected: Never poke-war her; last-hit at the edge of Barrel Roll range and save the cask slow for her step-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rated HARD at 8.5/10 while the Emerald+ win rate is 52.66% over 188 games and the packet chart hands Gragas three stages outright.
audit.why: A 52.66% win rate with Gragas winning Levels 4-5, 6 and first item is not a hard matchup. The difficulty enum, tone and every prose restatement of 8.5/10 contradicted the data.
audit.corrected: Set to EVEN, 5/10, with the difficulty framed around baiting Blinding Assault rather than surviving.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every one of the seven level-chart sides disagreed with the packet chart, and several disagreed with their own why text.
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Quinn, Skill, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Skill. audit.corrected: Chart set to Quinn / Skill / Skill / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Skill in both layers, with ratings moved to match, as one atomic group.

audit.why: Blinding Assault 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, Vault 12/11/10/9/8s, Body Slam 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s. The punish window is the gap between her Q being spent and it coming back.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are Quinn's window — her Harrier mark and ranged autos chunk you before W or Happy Hour stacks exist to heal it back, so don't walk up to throw a Q she'll just sidestep. Last-hit at the edge of Q range and accept some poke; the cask slow is your only answer to her kite, so never waste it as pure poke. Crucially, respect her E: the Vault knocks you back AND blinds your next auto, so don't commit your own E into her until she's used it.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are Quinn's window — her Harrier mark and ranged autos chunk you before W or Happy Hour stacks exist to heal it back, so don't walk up to throw a Q she'll just sidestep. Last-hit at the edge of Q range and accept some poke; the cask slow is your only answer to her kite, so never waste it as pure poke. Crucially, get her kit right: Blinding Assault (Q) is what blinds your auto, and Vault only leaps her away from you — bait the Q first.

edits.before: Late game flips back toward her. Once Quinn has items she stops dueling me entirely — she perma-roams with Harrier move speed, kites my telegraphed E and Q from outside my range, and her Vault knocks me out of any all-in I start. Win the lane early so her scaling never matters: build a lead with my 6 and first-item spike, then shove and look for picks with Cask rather than chasing her nimble frame around the map. If she's already ahead, give up the side lane and play Explosive Cask as a teamfight peel/engage tool for my team.

notes: Two hard factual errors fixed: the blind is Blinding Assault (Q), not Vault (E), and Vault does not knock Gragas back — Riot's text has Quinn leaping herself off the target to max attack range. The page repeated both errors in tldr, early, late, dosFull, dontsFull, report[5] and wants.foe. Also added the range fact (her Q 1025 vs your Q 850) that explains why the poke war is unwinnable. Level chart was wrong in all seven rows against the packet; flipped as one atomic group with ratings. Difficulty was HARD/8.5 against a 52.66% Emerald+ win rate over 188 games — reset to EVEN/5. Quinn's R is flagged as an interruptible channel in the kit, but whether Gragas E or Cask actually cancels Behind Enemy Lines mid-flight is not stated in Riot's text, so I wrote no advice around it; see questionsForUser.
